names.legendary: The Loaf That Fed a Week of Lunches

lore.common: Sits in the bread bin with two crusty ends that nobody wants to eat.
lore.uncommon: Goes stale on one side while the other side is still soft.
lore.rare: Makes the whole kitchen smell so warm and bready that everyone wants toast.
lore.epic: Made so many sandwiches for a school trip that the coach smelled like a bakery.
lore.legendary: Made a week of lunches for a family of six, and the crusts went to the ducks.

names.legendary: The Panini That Stretched Forever

lore.common: Has stripes across its top from the hot press, like a tiny zebra.
lore.uncommon: Oozes cheese from its edges onto the plate and the fingers.
lore.rare: Stretches so much when bitten that the cheese reaches arm's length.
lore.epic: Stretched its cheese so far at lunch that two friends were joined across the table.
lore.legendary: Stretched a string of cheese so long that it was measured with a tape measure and broke a record.

names.legendary: The Roll That Held a Whole Picnic

lore.common: Holds its filling for exactly one bite before it starts to escape.
lore.uncommon: Covers everyone who eats it in a fine layer of crumbs.
lore.rare: Squeezes its filling out the back with every bite.
lore.epic: Was squashed at the bottom of the picnic bag and came out flat as a pancake but still delicious.
lore.legendary: Held a whole picnic's worth of filling in one roll, and four people shared it.

names.legendary: The Cake That Fed a Whole School

lore.common: Has a layer of icing on top that everyone wants to lick off first.
lore.uncommon: Sinks a little in the middle, no matter how carefully it's baked.
lore.rare: Makes everyone at the party stop talking when it's carried in.
lore.epic: Leaned so far on the way to the table that three people had to catch it.
lore.legendary: Was cut into enough slices for a whole school, and every child got a corner.

names.legendary: The Candle That Granted the Wish

lore.common: Stands on a cake and waits for one big puff and a wish.
lore.uncommon: Drips coloured wax onto the icing every time it's lit for too long.
lore.rare: Comes back to life after being blown out, and everyone has to blow again.
lore.epic: Relit itself five times at a party, and the birthday boy was out of breath.
lore.legendary: Was blown out with a wish so perfect that the whole party says it came true.

names.legendary: The Pop That Never Fell Off Its Stick

lore.common: Is a ball of cake on a stick, covered in shiny icing and sprinkles.
lore.uncommon: Falls off its stick when bitten too hard.
lore.rare: Looks so perfect that nobody wants to be the first to eat one.
lore.epic: Was dropped at a party and rolled across the floor like a tiny bowling ball.
lore.legendary: Stayed on its stick through a whole party of bouncing children, which is unheard of.

names.legendary: The Sweet That Was Shared Fairly

lore.common: Comes in a crinkly wrapper that is impossible to open quietly.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to teeth so firmly that talking becomes difficult.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who eats one suddenly full of energy.
lore.epic: Was shared out at a party so fast that the bag was empty in a minute.
lore.legendary: Was split into perfect shares between six children, and nobody argued once.

names.legendary: The Caramel That Glued a Family Together

lore.common: Is gooey and golden and sticks to the wrapper as it's opened.
lore.uncommon: Glues jaws together so firmly that nobody can talk for a minute.
lore.rare: Stretches so far when bitten that it becomes a long golden thread.
lore.epic: Stuck so many fingers together at a party that everyone held hands by accident.
lore.legendary: Was so sticky that it glued a whole family together at the sofa for a film night.

names.legendary: The Gum That Blew the Biggest Bubble

lore.common: Gets chewed until it loses its flavour, then chewed for a bit longer anyway.
lore.uncommon: Ends up stuck under a desk, a shoe or a cinema seat.
lore.rare: Blows bubbles so big that they pop all over the chewer's face.
lore.epic: Blew a bubble so big that it popped and covered a whole fringe.
lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so huge that a passing bird thought it was a balloon.

names.legendary: The Gummy That Survived the Bag

lore.common: Wobbles when it's held up and squishes when it's bitten.
lore.uncommon: Sticks together in a big lump with all the other gummies in the bag.
lore.rare: Is so chewy that one sweet lasts a whole walk to school.
lore.epic: Got stuck in a big gummy clump that had to be shared with a pair of scissors.
lore.legendary: Was the only gummy left in the bag after a whole school trip.

names.legendary: The Bean That Was Every Flavour

lore.common: Comes in every colour, and nobody can guess what any of them taste like.
lore.uncommon: Always has one flavour that nobody likes, left at the bottom of the bag.
lore.rare: Makes every bag a guessing game that ends in silly faces.
lore.epic: Was used for a flavour game at a party, and everyone made the same face at once.
lore.legendary: Tasted of every flavour at once, and nobody could ever agree what it was.

names.legendary: The Licorice Nobody Else Liked

lore.common: Is black and chewy and makes everybody's tongue go dark.
lore.uncommon: Is either loved or hated, with nobody in between.
lore.rare: Is so stretchy that a single string can be wrapped round a wrist.
lore.epic: Was tied in a bow at a party, and the whole class tried to copy it.
lore.legendary: Was the only sweet left in the bag at every party, and one grandad loved it for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Lolly Bigger Than a Face

lore.common: Has a big rainbow swirl on a stick and lasts for hours.
lore.uncommon: Gets fluff and hair stuck on it the moment it's put down.
lore.rare: Is so big that its owner has to lick it all afternoon.
lore.epic: Was licked for a whole day at a fairground and was still only half finished.
lore.legendary: Was so big that its owner hid behind it during a game of hide and seek.

names.legendary: The Mint That Froze a Whole Mouth

lore.common: Makes breath cool and fresh and the whole mouth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Gets offered round after every dinner whether anyone wants one or not.
lore.rare: Is so strong that the whole mouth feels like it is on an iceberg.
lore.epic: Was passed round after dinner, and the whole table breathed out a cloud of mint.
lore.legendary: Was so minty that its eater breathed out a little cloud of frost.

names.legendary: The Toffee That Lasted a Year

lore.common: Is hard and golden and needs a little hammer to break it.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to teeth so hard that it pulls at them when chewed.
lore.rare: Lasts so long in the mouth that it can be sucked all afternoon.
lore.epic: Was so sticky at a party that nobody could talk for ten minutes.
lore.legendary: Was sucked for a whole year by one very patient grandad, a little bit each Sunday.

names.legendary: The Truffle Everyone Wanted

lore.common: Is a little ball of chocolate dusted with cocoa that melts on fingers.
lore.uncommon: Melts in the hand before it reaches the mouth.
lore.rare: Is so rich that one bite is enough, though nobody stops at one.
lore.epic: Was the last truffle in the box, and the whole family played a game to win it.
lore.legendary: Was the most wanted sweet at a party, and the winner shared it with everyone anyway.

names.legendary: The Brownie the Whole School Wanted

lore.common: Has a crackly top and a gooey middle that sticks to the tin.
lore.uncommon: Has corners that are fought over and a middle that falls apart.
lore.rare: Is so gooey that its eater needs a fork, a spoon and a napkin.
lore.epic: Was taken to a bake sale, and every brownie sold in one minute.
lore.legendary: Was so delicious that the whole school talked about it until the end of term.

names.legendary: The Bar That Melted Every Heart

lore.common: Snaps into neat squares and melts on warm fingers.
lore.uncommon: Melts in the pocket into a puddle that ruins a pair of trousers.
lore.rare: Is so tasty that one square always turns into three.
lore.epic: Melted in a hot car and smeared its whole wrapper into one big chocolate puddle.
lore.legendary: Was shared out so lovingly at a party that every person got exactly the same number of squares.

names.legendary: The Fudge That Sold Out the Pier

lore.common: Is soft and crumbly and so sweet that it makes teeth tingle.
lore.uncommon: Crumbles into pieces when it's cut, so nobody gets a neat square.
lore.rare: Is so sweet that one cube makes the eater giddy for an hour.
lore.epic: Was sold on the seaside pier, and the queue stretched to the beach.
lore.legendary: Sold out the whole pier on a summer day, and the gulls gathered to sniff the empty trays.

names.legendary: The Cookie That Fed Every Pocket

lore.common: Has chocolate chips scattered through it and crumbs that go everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Breaks in half in the milk and sinks to the bottom.
lore.rare: Smells so good while baking that the whole house waits in the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was dunked so long that it collapsed into the milk, and the glass became a soup.
lore.legendary: Was baked in a batch so big that every child at school had one in their pocket.

names.legendary: The Cookie With the Funniest Message

lore.common: Has a tiny paper message inside that is never quite what anyone expected.
lore.uncommon: Snaps so loudly when opened that it makes the whole table jump.
lore.rare: Gives a message so silly that the whole table reads it aloud.
lore.epic: Gave everyone at the table the same message, and they all laughed for an hour.
lore.legendary: Gave a message so funny that a grandad laughed until his tea went cold.

names.legendary: The Biscuit That Ran Away

lore.common: Has icing buttons down his front and a big smile on his face.
lore.uncommon: Loses a leg first, always, whenever someone takes a bite.
lore.rare: Looks so cheeky that everyone thinks he might run off the plate.
lore.epic: Was baked in a batch that rolled off the tray and across the kitchen floor.
lore.legendary: Ran out of the oven so fast that the cook only caught him at the garden gate.

names.legendary: The Macaron That Was Too Pretty to Eat

lore.common: Is a pastel-coloured little sandwich with a crisp shell and a soft middle.
lore.uncommon: Crumbles all over the plate the moment it's picked up.
lore.rare: Is so pretty that people take photos before they dare to eat it.
lore.epic: Was laid out at a fancy tea in a rainbow, and nobody wanted to break the line.
lore.legendary: Was so pretty that it sat in a cake shop window for a week and nobody dared to buy it.

names.legendary: The Cookie Shaped Like a Star

lore.common: Is a flat shiny biscuit covered in icing and sprinkles.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a trail of sprinkles wherever it goes.
lore.rare: Gets decorated so much that there is more icing than biscuit.
lore.epic: Was decorated at a party until the kitchen table was covered in sprinkles.
lore.legendary: Was cut into a star so perfect that it was hung on the wall instead of eaten.

names.legendary: The Wafer That Never Crumbled

lore.common: Has thin crispy layers with sweet cream in between.
lore.uncommon: Snaps into a shower of crumbs when bitten.
lore.rare: Is so crispy that every bite sounds like a small firework.
lore.epic: Snapped so loudly at a quiet film that the whole cinema turned round.
lore.legendary: Was bitten by a whole class one after another and never crumbled once.

names.legendary: The Croissant That Flaked a Whole Cafe

lore.common: Is curved like a moon and leaves buttery flakes on every shirt.
lore.uncommon: Gets so crumbly that half of it ends up on the plate.
lore.rare: Flakes so much that the table looks like it has been snowing.
lore.epic: Covered a whole cafe table in flakes at breakfast, and the birds came to the window.
lore.legendary: Flaked so much on its way through a cafe that every table got a share.

names.legendary: The Cupcake With the Tallest Icing

lore.common: Has a swirl of icing on top that's bigger than the cake underneath.
lore.uncommon: Leaves icing on the nose of whoever bites it first.
lore.rare: Is so tempting that everyone takes one more than they meant to.
lore.epic: Was stacked in a tower for a party and toppled when someone took one from the bottom.
lore.legendary: Had icing so tall that it needed its own box to travel to the party.

names.legendary: The Donut That Never Dripped Jam

lore.common: Has a hole in the middle and sugar that covers every finger.
lore.uncommon: Squirts jam out of its side with the first bite.
lore.rare: Is so sugary that its eater licks their lips for an hour.
lore.epic: Squirted jam across a whole shirt, and the jam made a funny face.
lore.legendary: Was eaten in one bite without dripping jam or dropping sugar, which nobody believed.

names.legendary: The Egg That Never Broke Its Yolk

lore.common: Sits in the pan with its sunny yolk in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Breaks its yolk the moment it's flipped.
lore.rare: Has edges so crispy that they crunch with every bite.
lore.epic: Was flipped so high that it landed on the cat's head.
lore.legendary: Was flipped, served and eaten without its yolk breaking, which no egg has ever managed.

names.legendary: The Omelette That Folded Perfectly

lore.common: Folds over its filling like a yellow blanket.
lore.uncommon: Tears in half when it's flipped, so it turns into scrambled eggs.
lore.rare: Is so fluffy that it rises in the pan like a soft cushion.
lore.epic: Was flipped so high that it landed on the next-door plate.
lore.legendary: Folded so perfectly that the chef cried with joy.

names.legendary: The Eggs That Were Perfectly Fluffy

lore.common: Is soft and yellow and sticks to the pan if it isn't stirred.
lore.uncommon: Gets cold so quickly that the toast is always warmer.
lore.rare: Is so fluffy that it nearly floats off the plate.
lore.epic: Was scrambled so much at a Sunday breakfast that the whole table got a share.
lore.legendary: Was scrambled so perfectly that the eggs looked like little yellow clouds.

names.legendary: The Fries That Were Never Cold

lore.common: Come in a paper cone, crispy on the outside and soft in the middle.
lore.uncommon: Get stolen one by one by whoever is sitting nearest.
lore.rare: Are so crispy that they crunch loudly enough to be heard across the room.
lore.epic: Were stolen by a seagull on the seafront, and the whole beach chased it.
lore.legendary: Stayed hot for a whole walk home from the chip shop, which is unheard of.

names.legendary: The Yoghurt That Never Melted

lore.common: Swirls into a cup and gets covered in toppings until it disappears.
lore.uncommon: Melts faster than its toppings can be eaten.
lore.rare: Gets so many toppings that it looks like a small mountain.
lore.epic: Was piled so high with toppings that the cup tipped over.
lore.legendary: Stayed frozen through a whole summer's day at the beach, and the ice cream van was jealous.

names.legendary: The Cup That Made Every Holiday

lore.common: Comes in a little cup with a tiny spade-shaped spoon.
lore.uncommon: Melts down the side of the cup faster than anyone can eat it.
lore.rare: Is so creamy that every spoonful slows down its eater.
lore.epic: Was the best part of a whole holiday, and the family ate one every day.
lore.legendary: Was so good on a holiday that the family planned their whole next trip around it.

names.legendary: The Cone That Never Dripped

lore.common: Has a scoop of ice cream on a cone that starts to drip at once.
lore.uncommon: Drips down the cone and onto its eater's fingers in the sun.
lore.rare: Melts so quickly that its eater has to lick it in circles.
lore.epic: Was dropped on the sand, and a whole flock of seagulls came running.
lore.legendary: Was eaten on a sunny day without a single drip, which nobody believes.

names.legendary: The Sundae Taller Than a Child

lore.common: Has scoops of ice cream, sauce and a cherry, all in a tall glass.
lore.uncommon: Has a cherry on top that everyone wants and nobody shares.
lore.rare: Is so tall that its eater needs a long spoon to reach the bottom.
lore.epic: Was ordered at the ice cream parlour so big that three children shared it.
lore.legendary: Was so tall that it was taller than the child eating it.

names.legendary: The Box That Fed a Party

lore.common: Holds a slice of pizza that flops when it's picked up.
lore.uncommon: Leaves a cheese string from the box to the mouth on every bite.
lore.rare: Smells so good that everyone near it suddenly wants pizza.
lore.epic: Was opened at a party, and every slice was gone before the music started.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole party from one box, and somehow there was still a slice left for the pizza delivery rider.

names.legendary: The Popcorn That Filled a Cinema

lore.common: Pops in the pan and fills the kitchen with a lovely buttery smell.
lore.uncommon: Spills on the sofa and stays in the cushions for weeks.
lore.rare: Hides one unpopped kernel in every handful, waiting for the softest tooth.
lore.epic: Spilled all over the lounge on film night, and the dog had the best evening of its life.
lore.legendary: Filled a whole cinema with its smell, and the people outside queued to come in.

names.legendary: The Wrap That Fed a Festival

lore.common: Is wrapped in warm pita bread with sauce dripping down the side.
lore.uncommon: Drips its sauce onto the shoes of whoever is eating it.
lore.rare: Gets wrapped so tightly that the last bite squirts sauce right up its eater's sleeve.
lore.epic: Was so popular at a festival that the queue went round the whole field.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole festival in one weekend, and the cook was carried round on shoulders.

names.legendary: The Quesadilla That Pulled Forever

lore.common: Is a folded tortilla full of melted cheese, cut into wedges.
lore.uncommon: Lets one wedge slide off the plate every time it is carried to the table.
lore.rare: Hides a pocket of molten cheese in its middle wedge, so whoever gets it gasps.
lore.epic: Was cut into so many wedges at a party that it looked like a giant golden clock.
lore.legendary: Pulled a string of cheese so long that it went out of the door and down the path.

names.legendary: The Wrap That Was Worth the Queue

lore.common: Is sliced from a big turning spit and wrapped with salad and sauce.
lore.uncommon: Drips garlic sauce on the floor with every bite.
lore.rare: Turns on its spit so hypnotically that the whole queue forgets what it was going to order.
lore.epic: Was so popular that the queue outside the shop went round the block.
lore.legendary: Was worth a two-hour queue, and every person in the line said so afterwards.

names.legendary: The Taco That Held Its Filling

lore.common: Crunches loudly at the first bite and then falls apart completely.
lore.uncommon: Drops its filling on the plate after every bite.
lore.rare: Shatters into so many pieces at the first bite that the plate ends up with more taco than the mouth.
lore.epic: Collapsed so badly at taco night that everyone ate theirs with a fork.
lore.legendary: Held its filling all the way to the last bite, and the whole table stood up and clapped.

names.legendary: The Wrap That Never Unrolled

lore.common: Is rolled tight with filling and wrapped in foil for lunch.
lore.uncommon: Unrolls at the worst moment and drops its filling on the desk.
lore.rare: Holds so much filling that it gets fatter in the middle.
lore.epic: Unrolled in a lunchbox, and the whole thing became a salad.
lore.legendary: Stayed perfectly rolled through a whole school trip, and the teacher was amazed.

names.legendary: The Pie That Won the Village Show

lore.common: Has a crisscross top and smells of apples and cinnamon.
lore.uncommon: Burns the tongue of anyone who can't wait for it to cool.
lore.rare: Steams so much when it's cut that the whole kitchen smells of autumn.
lore.epic: Was left to cool on a windowsill, and three neighbours and a fox turned up to admire it.
lore.legendary: Won the village show three years running, and the judges asked for seconds each time.

names.legendary: The Bun That Was Fluffier Than a Cloud

lore.common: Is soft and white and steamed until it's as squishy as a pillow.
lore.uncommon: Sticks to the paper underneath it and tears at the bottom.
lore.rare: Is so fluffy that it springs back when it's squeezed.
lore.epic: Was steamed so well at a party that everyone wanted to squeeze it like a cushion.
lore.legendary: Was so fluffy that a whole table agreed it was softer than a cloud.

names.legendary: The Tin That Held Sewing Things

lore.common: Rattles when it's picked up, which means there are still biscuits inside.
lore.uncommon: Has only broken biscuits and crumbs at the bottom when it's finally opened.
lore.rare: Makes a sound when opened that brings every person in the house to the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was opened at a family party, and everyone fought over the chocolate ones.
lore.legendary: Was opened with great excitement, but it held sewing things, as everyone's grandmother's tin does.
